title: Alas Women ousted by Kazakhstan from Asian Games contention, relegated to classification
summary: Alas Pilipinas Women were ousted by Kazakhstan from medal contention, 29-27, 24-26, 23-25, 19-25, in the women's volleyball tournament of the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games on Thursday.
